==Related skills==
*{{skill icon|Storm of Swords}}
*{{skill icon|Vow of Strength}} ([[elite]])

==Notes==
*Synergizes well with [[attack skill]]s that can cause multiple attacks with a sword ([[Sun and Moon Slash]] and [[Twin Moon Sweep]]) and with [[hex spell]]s that deal damage whenever the hexed foe takes [[physical damage]] ([[Barbs]] and [[Mark of Pain]]).
**When Whirlwind Attack is used, this skill will trigger for each adjacent foe attacked.
*Because this triggers ''on attack'', you don't actually have to hit for the damage to occur.
*The damage from Hundred Blades is inflicted before the damage from your sword. This is relevant for skills such as [[Reversal of Fortune]] or [[Empathy]].
*Because this damages all "adjacent foes", [[Kite|kiting]] opponents will avoid damage if they have moved away by the time the attack connects.
*If you are using an [[emote]] when using this skill, no animation will show until you stop doing the emote. The animation will stack with several Hundred Blades.

==Trivia==
*This skill was non-elite prior to the release of [[Prophecies]] and the reason why Warriors have one elite skill more than other [[core]] professions. (See [[Mantra of Celerity]].)
*This is one of five (nine in {{reforgedmode}}) elite skills seen in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]], where it is used by [[Prince Rurik]]. The other four are [[Barrage]], [[Bull's Charge]], [[Earth Shaker]], and [[Ward Against Harm]] (with [["Victory Is Mine!"]], [[Greater Conflagration]], [[Plague Signet]], and [[Elemental Attunement]] in Reforged Mode).
*The swords seen in the [[skill icon]] are [[Gladius (gladius)|Gladii]].
